Repo: /home/ubuntu/.t3/worktrees/surveybeat-next/t3-e359cb80-34a8fa3c5f0820ad (T3 linked worktree, branch `t3/plan-next-round-issues`, uses GitButler `but`; in a linked worktree `but pull` can fail, plain `git push -u origin HEAD` is acceptable if `but push` refuses). Steps asked for: push the branch and open a pull request against `main`. Do not merge. Do not commit anything else: the uncommitted `.githooks/*` files are unrelated and must stay out.

The change is the single commit "R1 239: the Organization object is the only Email queue producer" (already committed; the fence gate passed: typecheck, lint, format, ledger, comments, 1207 unit and 241 privacy tests). Issue: #239 (use "Fixes #239").

PR title: `R1 239: the Organization object is the only Email queue producer`
PR body (use exactly, ending with the attribution line):

## Why
Since #240 the Organization object's transactional outbox puts every send it creates or requeues on the Email queue. The Worker-side `EmailOutbox` still queued the same sends, so each got two queue messages and there were two dispatchers. Fixes #239.

## What changed
- Removed the domain `EmailOutbox` service and its callers (`DirectoryFlow`, `PulseFlow`), the `QueueEmail` follow-up and the resend `queue` flag, `queueEmail`, the MainWorker outbox and its Email queue producer binding (the consumer stays), and the test fakes.
- Test fixture: `TestInvitationTestRoutes` used to claim and settle a test send by hand, which raced the outbox delivering it. A test-stage-only Organization RPC, `createFailedTestSend`, now creates and fails a test send in one transaction.
- Resend of a still-Pending send no longer re-queues: its outbox row stays until the queue accepts the batch.
- `/__test/email` POST creates the fixture Organization row first, since the outbox reads it to build the queue message.

## Verification
Fence gate: typecheck, lint, format, ledger, comments, 1207 unit tests, 241 privacy tests. Adapter tests for EmailDelivery, EmailOutbox, Organization, DirectoryApi and PulsesApi pass on local workerd.

## Not covered
The test-Invitation fixture's first burst send and bulk sends still have outbox rows (since #240) and could in principle be dispatched while the route runs. Low likelihood; not changed here.

Return the PR URL and head SHA.

content.text:
The pull request is open against `main` and the branch is pushed. I did not merge it.

- **PR:** https://github.com/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next/pull/246
- **Head SHA:** `083746936c0e1f1d88b46b85e6281051a31a3428`
- **Commit:** `083746936c0e1f1d88b46b85e6281051a31a3428` "R1 239: the Organization object is the only Email queue producer" (already committed, not amended)
- **Branch pushed:** `t3/plan-next-round-issues`, tracking `origin/t3/plan-next-round-issues`

**Push:** the first attempt was rejected by the GitHub server with a pack-write error, not an auth refusal. I retried once with the same plain `git push -u origin HEAD` and it succeeded. I did not use the SSH or HTTPS fallback, and the signing path was not involved since no new commit was made.

**Left out:** the unrelated `.githooks/*` files (one modified, five untracked) are still uncommitted in the worktree.

**Issue to note:** the existing commit's message ends with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. The rules forbid attribution lines in commits. I did not rewrite it, because amending or rebasing needs an explicit request. If you want it removed, it needs a separate instruction to amend and force-push.
